metadata.title: Cisplatin 100 mg/m² with Radiotherapy
metadata.indication: Chemoradiation for locally advanced stage III–IV squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

provenance.source: NCCP regimen PDF / Head and Neck catalogue

metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: NCCP version 5 reconciled to executable thresholds, eligibility, monitoring, RT coordination and explicit local safety guards; independent clinical/pharmacy approval remains pending.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Discuss all changes with the Consultant. The output states source percentages, not a prescription; do not multiply independent reductions, infer a restart dose, substitute eGFR for CrCl, or apply another cisplatin regimen’s thresholds.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00387 Version 5. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Chemoradiation for locally advanced stage III–IV squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck.

treatment.schedule_summary: Cisplatin 100 mg/m² every 21 days with RT for 3 cycles unless progression or unacceptable toxicity.
treatment.rt_coordination: Give cisplatin before RT on the same day. If RT is cancelled, postpone cisplatin until RT resumes.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest emetogenic active component and phase-specific NCCP classification.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for high emetogenic risk
supportive_care.hydration: Pre- and post-cisplatin hydration with electrolyte supplementation according to the current NCCP regimen and local policy; no routine furosemide unless fluid overload.
supportive_care.oral_hydration: Encourage oral hydration for 24 hours, individualised to clinical status.

baseline: Audiology and creatinine clearance if clinically indicated
before_each_cycle: History of ototoxicity and sensory neural symptoms
monitoring.disease_monitoring: Individual Consultant treatment plan; source does not prescribe a universal scan or tumour-marker schedule.

treatment_phases.label: Cisplatin with radiotherapy
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: Cisplatin 100 mg/m² every 21 days with RT for 3 cycles unless progression or unacceptable toxicity. Give cisplatin before RT on the same day. If RT is cancelled, postpone cisplatin until RT resumes.

administration.notes: Over 120 minutes, with hydration and electrolyte management as prescribed. Cisplatin precedes same-day RT; postpone cisplatin if RT is cancelled.
